headline: A law that renames a Montrose, Colorado post office after Sergeant David Kinterknecht, signed December 21, 2018.
what_it_does: This law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 3025 Woodgate Road in Montrose, Colorado, the "Sergeant David Kinterknecht Post Office." It is a naming law only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the new name applies from that date.
